replaces: A_O2_HeadBase (from R19_UpperBillYawClearance, built on XGO head.stl)
design_basis: IndieDuck parameters only: outline numbers (front x 96.5, rear apex x -19, half width 44, rear half-ellipse from x 22), 5 mm floor at z 218.5 matching the parts that sit on it, mouth-cradle pad and camera-carrier bosses from those parts, screw clearances from IndieDuck fastener references, clearance envelopes from IndieDuck moving parts. No XGO geometry used.
native_source: native/robot/IndieDuck_R25_HeadBase.FCStd (PartDesign body with Params sheet; HeadBase_Final is the body after the clearance cut)
slicing: Bambu Studio 2.08 CLI, P2S 0.4 mm, 0.20 mm, 3 walls, 20 % infill: flat on its underside, no supports, no warnings, 25.8 g, 56 min
notes: front half is 7 mm narrower each side than the XGO part: the jaw sides sweep through there; two 499 mm3 edge strips left unconnected by that clearance were removed
the jaw overlapped a plain floor by up to 1.9 cm3 when closed; the new base clears the jaw through 0..32 deg, which R25 had not checked
